title: charybdis numidica
intro: Charybdis numidica, commonly known as the Numidian swallowwort, is a plant species in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Charybdis numidica include its use as a treatment for various ailments, such as fever and skin conditions, due to its ability to stimulate sweating, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Charybdis numidica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
